source: llama-server --help captured from this exact build: version 0.3.0-dev (build 50, commit 035e227), built with GNU 13.3.0 for Linux aarch64. Seeded from the b7000 registry file and extended with the flags that build carries and b7000 does not.
notes: NOT an upstream llama.cpp release. This is a build of the unmerged PR #27742 (qwen4exp / Qwen3.8-Flash-Next architecture support) at commit 035e227, which self-reports the placeholder version 0.3.0-dev and build number 50 rather than a real bNNNN build number. It is recorded as its own square (engine_minor falls back to the whole string) because its flag surface and its supported architectures both differ from any released build. Two patches from github.com/0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark are applied on top: canreuse-qwen4exp.patch, which implements can_reuse() for llm_graph_input_qsa and llm_graph_input_ple so CUDA graphs actually engage (graphs reused 0 -> non-zero, decode +2.8%), and rowband-ple-quant.patch, which only matters when quantizing. The three flags this recipe turns on - override-tensor, load-mode and spec-type - are absent from the b7000 registry file entirely. The mmproj entry was added on 2026-08-30 after a run used it: the file was hand-seeded from --help as a 53-flag subset and missed it, though the binary accepts it (-mm, env LLAMA_ARG_MMPROJ).

params.name: alias
params.help: Model name reported by the API. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: api-key
params.help: Required API key. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: batch-size
params.help: Logical maximum batch size.

params.name: cache-type-k
params.help: KV cache key type. q8_0 and q4_0 trade accuracy for cache size.

params.name: cache-type-v
params.help: KV cache value type. Needs flash attention for the quantized types.

params.name: chat-template
params.help: Override the chat template by name.

params.name: cont-batching
params.help: Continuous batching. On by default in llama-server.

params.name: ctx-size
params.help: Context size in tokens. 0 means take it from the GGUF metadata.

params.name: defrag-thold
params.help: KV cache defragmentation threshold.

params.name: device
params.help: Explicit backend device list.

params.name: draft-max
params.help: Maximum draft tokens per speculative step.

params.name: draft-min
params.help: Minimum draft tokens per speculative step.

params.name: flash-attn
params.help: Flash attention. auto enables it where the backend supports it.

params.name: gpu-layers-draft
params.help: Draft-model layers offloaded to the GPU.

params.name: host
params.help: Bind address. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: jinja
params.help: Use the GGUF's Jinja chat template. Required for tool calls on most recent models.

params.name: keep
params.help: Tokens of the prompt kept when the context is shifted.

params.name: kv-unified
params.help: Single unified KV buffer shared by all slots.

params.name: load-mode
params.help: Model loading mode: auto, none, or mmap. auto already memory-maps unless a device cannot; passing mmap forces it. Recorded explicitly here because the whole point of this configuration is that the n-gram table is paged from storage rather than loaded.

params.name: main-gpu
params.help: GPU used for small tensors and, with split-mode none, everything.

params.name: metrics
params.help: Expose the Prometheus endpoint. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: min-p
params.help: Min-p sampling.

params.name: mlock
params.help: Lock the model in RAM.

params.name: mmproj
params.help: Path to a multimodal projector file. Without it this build serves the model text-only: the GGUF shards carry no vision tensors, because llama.cpp ships multimodal as a separate projector and unsloth publishes it alongside as mmproj-BF16.gguf / mmproj-F16.gguf (~0.9 GB). Passing it is what makes image input work at all, so it belongs in the fingerprint: two runs of this model differing only in --mmproj are not the same configuration.

params.name: model
params.help: GGUF file to load. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: model-draft
params.help: Draft model for speculative decoding.

params.name: n-gpu-layers
params.help: Layers offloaded to the GPU. Use a large number (999) for all. Builds with a GPU backend compiled in may offload everything by default — verify against your build and record what you passed.

params.name: n-predict
params.help: Server-side cap on generated tokens.

params.name: no-cont-batching
params.help: Disable continuous batching.

params.name: no-mmap
params.help: Read the whole model instead of memory-mapping it. Slower to start, avoids page-cache thrash.

params.name: no-webui
params.help: Disable the built-in web UI. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: numa
params.help: NUMA optimisation strategy.

params.name: override-tensor
params.help: Override the buffer type for tensors matching a pattern, as <tensor name pattern>=<buffer type>. This recipe passes per_layer_token_embd=CPU to keep the 51.2B n-gram/PLE table off the accelerator; combined with load-mode mmap it is then served from NVMe through the OS page cache and never becomes resident. Decisive for whether a 180B model fits in 128 GB at all.

params.name: parallel
params.help: Number of server slots. This build reports 'default: -1, -1 = auto' in --help, so -1 is recorded here rather than the 1 carried by the b7000 file; that keeps an explicit --parallel 1 in the fingerprint, which matters because concurrent requests on the qwen4exp architecture are only safe while there is a single slot.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: reasoning-format
params.help: How reasoning content is returned.

params.name: repeat-penalty
params.help: Repetition penalty. 1.0 disables it.

params.name: rope-freq-base
params.help: RoPE base frequency. 0 keeps the model's own.

params.name: rope-freq-scale
params.help: RoPE frequency scaling factor.

params.name: rope-scaling
params.help: RoPE scaling method.

params.name: seed
params.help: Random seed. -1 is random.

params.name: slots
params.help: Expose the slots endpoint. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: spec-type
params.help: Comma-separated speculative decoding types: none, draft-simple, draft-eagle3, draft-mtp, draft-dflash, draft-dspark, ngram-simple, ngram-map-k, ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod, ngram-cache. ngram-mod drafts spans from repetition already in the context, so it needs no draft model and no extra memory. Speculation is exact - the target verifies every token - so output is unchanged, but throughput varies up to 3x by how much of the output already appears in the prompt. Never compare a decode number across two different values of this flag.

params.name: split-mode
params.help: How to split across multiple GPUs.

params.name: swa-full
params.help: Keep the full KV cache for sliding-window models.

params.name: temp
params.help: Sampling temperature.

params.name: tensor-split
params.help: Per-GPU split proportions.

params.name: threads
params.help: CPU threads for generation. -1 means one per physical core.

params.name: threads-batch
params.help: CPU threads for prompt processing.

params.name: threads-http
params.help: HTTP worker threads. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: top-k
params.help: Top-k sampling.

params.name: top-p
params.help: Top-p sampling.

params.name: ubatch-size
params.help: Physical micro-batch size — the one that actually changes prefill speed.

params.name: yarn-orig-ctx
params.help: Original context size for YaRN scaling.
